verdict.rationale: dlt ships an official MCP server (dlt-mcp) whose server-card explicitly lists tools for 'inspecting, debugging, and managing dlt pipelines, secrets, schemas, and runs' plus read-only SQL queries against pipeline datasets, and docs describe CLI/Web UI monitoring to check pipeline health and diagnose failures. However, re-triggering a failed run specifically through the MCP server or API is not explicitly evidenced — only general 'deploy/schedule/backfill' commands via dlthub CLI/Python API are shown, not confirmed as MCP-exposed re-trigger actions. Missing for 10: explicit MCP tool for re-running/retriggering a failed pipeline, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the diagnose-then-retrigger workflow.
